title: iris × germanica subsp. pallida
intro: Iris × germanica subsp. pallida, commonly known as Dalmatian iris, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the iris family and is native to the Mediterranean region. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues due to its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dalmatian iris include its use as a diaphoretic to promote sweating, a diuretic to increase urine production, and an expectorant to relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
